#include <bits/stdc++.h>
#include <cstring>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;
const ll MOD = 998244353;

ll java_mul_mod(ll a, ll b, ll mod) {
    unsigned long long ua = (unsigned long long)a;
    unsigned long long ub = (unsigned long long)b;
    unsigned long long u = ua * ub;
    ll p;
    memcpy(&p, &u, sizeof(p));
    return p % mod;
}

ll qmod(ll a, ll b, ll mod) {
    ll ans = 1;
    while (b >= 1) {
        if (b & 1) ans = java_mul_mod(ans, a, mod);
        a = java_mul_mod(a, a, mod);
        b >>= 1;
    }
    return ans;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    ll n, m;
    int k;
    cin >> n >> m >> k;
    ll mod = MOD;
    m = qmod(m, mod - 2, mod);
    vector<ll> S(k + 1, 0);
    if (k >= 1) S[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i <= k; i++) {
        for (int j = i; j >= 1; j--) {
            if (j == i) {
                S[j] = 1;
            } else {
                S[j] = (java_mul_mod(S[j], j, mod) + S[j - 1]) % mod;
            }
        }
    }
    vector<ll> dp(5005, 0);
    dp[0] = 1;
    int limit = (int)min(n, (ll)k);
    for (int i = 1; i <= limit; i++) {
        dp[i] = java_mul_mod(dp[i - 1], n - i + 1, mod);
    }
    ll ans = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= limit; i++) {
        ll term = java_mul_mod(dp[i], qmod(m, i, mod), mod);
        term = java_mul_mod(term, S[i], mod);
        ans = (ans + term) % mod;
    }
    cout << ans << "\n";
    return 0;
}
